name: LinkSurgeWP
author: Smart AI WP

sections.description:
LinkSurgeWP Free is an advanced AI-powered content automation plugin that fetches and posts high-quality content. It creates one new post every hour and resets every 50 posts.

🚀 Key Features:
– AI-Powered Auto-Posting – Hands-free content automation.
– Hourly Posting – Publishes one post per hour, resets after 50 posts.
– SEO Optimization – AI-enhanced metadata and structure.
– Content Protection – Prevents unauthorized duplication.
– No Setup Needed – Installs & runs instantly.

Short Description

AI-powered content automation plugin that fetches and posts high-quality content every hour.
sections.installation:
1. Download and install the plugin via WordPress Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate LinkSurgeWP Free.
  3. AI auto-posting starts immediately upon activation.
  4. Visit WordPress Admin → Posts to check AI-generated content.
sections.faq:
How often does the AI post content?

  • AI generates a new post upon activation.
  • AI auto-posts every hour, up to 50 times. Once it hits 50, it resets and starts a fresh cycle.

Does this require API keys?

No setup is required. LinkSurgeWP Free works out of the box.
